name: Mayo LEADER Targeted Call 2026: Biodiversity and Sustainable Use of Water Resources

funder.name: Mayo Local Action Group (South West Mayo Development Company, LEADER 2023-27)

summary: A competitive LEADER call for community groups in County Mayo, Ireland, to fund habitat improvement, nature corridors, invasive species control, pollinator projects and water protection, starting with an expression of interest.

steps: Independent evaluation and Local Action Group decision

eligibility.rule: Start project activities and commit to project purchases only after signing the grant contract
Project does not negatively affect existing businesses, services or facilities

status.quote: Call Opens: 2 November 2026 EOI Closing Date: 11 December 2026

opens.quote: Call Opens: 2 November 2026 EOI Closing Date: 11 December 2026

deadline.quote: Call Opens: 2 November 2026 EOI Closing Date: 11 December 2026

applicant_types.quote: Mayo Local Action Group (LAG) is inviting community organisations and groups to submit Expressions of Interest (EOIs)

geography.quote: projects that support biodiversity, environmental protection, and the sustainable use of water resources across County Mayo

access.quote: To apply for LEADER funding, you must complete, sign and return an Expression of Interest form.

window.quote: Call Opens: 2 November 2026 EOI Closing Date: 11 December 2026

amount.quote: Projects seeking LEADER grant aid of between €5,000 and €50,000 are encouraged to apply.

pool.quote: With a total budget of €220,000 available across County Mayo

co_finance_required.quote: Capital: 75% of costs to a maximum €50,000 Analysis and Development: 90% of costs to a maximum €30,000 Training: 100% of costs to a maximum €50,000

effort.quote: To apply for LEADER funding, you must complete, sign and return an Expression of Interest form.
Step 1 - Expression of Interest (EOI) – this is used to determine project eligibility in principle. Those successful at EOI stage will be eligible to submit a full application.
the application will be subject to an independent evaluation prior to submission to Local Action Group (LAG) for final decision.

eligibility.quote: Project activity undertaken or commenced, or the purchase of goods or services engaged by the project applicant prior to the date of contract signing, shall not be eligible for LEADER funding.
Projects must not negatively impact existing businesses, services, or facilities locally, nationally, or within the EU.

co_finance.quote: Capital: 75% of costs to a maximum €50,000 Analysis and Development: 90% of costs to a maximum €30,000 Training: 100% of costs to a maximum €50,000

documents.quote: This form must be completed and returned with your Expression of Interest form to your local Implementing or Animating Partner.
